paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.48% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (+1.51%) and Nasdaq weakest (-0.74%). Brent crude changed +6.39% to 106.73. Gold changed +0.77% to 4,188.8999. Bitcoin changed -0.77% to 82,633.3438. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.24%, a relative move of -1.34%. Among the firms tracked, ConocoPhillips (+6.47%) and Shell (+5.49%) moved the most.
